content:
Let \(x\) be the distance Petya travels from streetlight 1 to the meeting point. Then Vasya travels \(99-x\) units.

\[
\frac{x}{99-x}=\frac{7}{4}
\]

\[
4x=7(99-x)=693-7x
\]

\[
11x=693 \implies x=63
\]

Petya started at streetlight 1, so the meeting streetlight is \(1+63=64\).

\[
\boxed{64}
\]
